maddeler.e:
يتأقلم (form IIq)
# يَتَأَقْلَمُ (yataʔaqlamu) /ja.ta.ʔaq.la.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
# يَتَأَقْلَمَ (yataʔaqlama) /ja.ta.ʔaq.la.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
# يَتَأَقْلَمْ (yataʔaqlam) /ja.ta.ʔaq.lam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَأَقْلَمَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
